lines.en: label rinspecial55:
scene otoharinoutside1
: So...are you gonna start? Or should I?
: You start. Talking about serious stuff is hard and awkward and I feel like I’ve been doing it with literally everyone lately.
: Plus, I’ve apparently already got another talk lined up for later tonight and I feel like I’m going to be the one to have to get that one started.
: On the bright side...at least you’re getting pizza?
: Yeah. That’s pretty much the only thing keeping me hanging on at this point, Otoha.
scene otoharinoutside2
: Hah...
: Being in a relationship is a lot of fucking work, isn’t it?
: Yeah. But that’s exactly why I-
: Shut up. You literally just told me to start and I’ve barely even said anything yet.
: My bad. The nerves are kicking in.
: There shouldn’t be any nerves at this point, Rin.
: There will always be nerves. I’m a nervous person. Especially around people as pretty and talented as you.
scene otoharinoutside3
: Think buttering me up will make me go any easier on you?
: Think? No. Hope? Yes.
: Well, it won't.
scene otoharinoutside4
: Thankfully...I’m not mad. So there’s not really anything to “go easy” about.

: I’m just...confused. Your parents breaking up is such a huge...important thing to hide from me. And I thought I made it plenty clear in the past that I don’t want you keeping those things to yourself.
: You have. But you also made it clear that you want things to be easy and fun and-
: Shut up. I’m still not done.
: Okay. But you might be better off just bringing a roll of duct tape with you whenever you leave the house from now on because I’m extremely bad at keeping quiet and might require some assistance.
scene otoharinoutside5
: I didn’t realize you were into that sort of thing.
: I am into literally anything you want to do to me whenever you are ready to actually do things to me. Which might be never at this rate because I suck at this.
: You wanna know what you really suck at? Understanding me.
scene otoharinoutside6
: Yeah...Yeah, that’s hard.
: It’s not just you, either. I’m kind of like that with everyone.
: If I don’t see or hear something firsthand and just have to figure out whatever the issue is on my own, I’m basically screwed. Which is one of the big reasons I didn’t tell you about my parents.
: Everything happened so quickly and I panicked because I’ve been making them out to be the paragon of all things lesbian and if they couldn’t last-
: You didn’t think we would either.
: It’s more like I didn’t think you would think we would last.
: I have no idea if we will or not. But it’s not like I’m in any rush to find out. I like taking things slow, remember?
: It’s hard not to. And if that sounded insulting, it wasn’t supposed to be. We’re just really different people on the inside.
scene otoharinoutside7
: Kind of ironic how the hardest part of dating a girl so far has been also just, you know, being a girl.
: As much as I want to tell you you’re looking at it all wrong and that has nothing to do with how, uhh...bumpy things have been so far, I can’t. You’re exactly right.
: That’s on me, though. I’ve got like, zero exposure to this sort of thing and all I really know is that I like you and don’t mind having your tongue in my mouth a few times a day.
: But where you’re wrong is thinking whatever happens between your parents has anything to do with us.
: It’s not like hearing about them splitting up is going to make me think, “Oh. I guess all lesbians are doomed now. How sad.”
scene otoharinoutside8
: See! Then this is just one more example of me not understanding something I’m supposed to understand because that’s exactly what I thought you’d think!
: I might be inexperienced, but I’m not a fucking idiot.
scene otoharinoutside9
: Well, I am and I apologize.
: It’s no secret that things are still a little weird with us and I just wanted to keep them as minimally weird as possible.
: But unfortunately, I am going to be further complicating our relationship by now being the only daughter of a fractured household who must go on an epic journey to pick up all of its pieces.
: I think you should maybe...leave the epic journey to the two of them. I doubt there’s much you can do to fix whatever problems may have led to this.
: I can’t fix their relationship. I can’t fix ours. What good even am I?
: Do you actually think we need “fixing?”
scene otoharinoutside10
: Do you?
: Nah. Just a little...tuning.
: Music analogy. Because we’re in the light music club. And we play music. You’re so cool.
: That better not be sarcasm.
: It’s not. I really do think you’re the coolest person, like...ever. And I’m sorry that I have once again burdened your greatness by accidentally exposing it to the downfall of my parents.
: Oh, please. The downfall of your parents is the least of my worries when it comes to our relationship right now.
scene otoharinoutside11
: Wait, no. Forget I said that. That came out wrong.
: I...didn’t mean to make it sound like I’m worrying about something. I’m good.
: It’s okay, Otoha. You can say it.
: Chances are I already know what it is anyway.
scene otoharinoutside12
: Then...
: If you already know what it is...how come you haven’t said anything about it?
: Because you’re wrong.
scene otoharinoutside13
: This is technically a new conversation, so I’m going to start this time if that’s okay with you.
: Good. Because I have no idea how I’d do it without sounding like a complete bitch.
: Can I start by asking you for a favor?
: A little unorthodox for the beginning to a serious talk, but sure.
: Have more faith in me.

: There’s a big difference between keeping things from you because I’m an idiot who can’t figure out how you’ll react and literally just straight up cheating on you with a girl who doesn’t even like me.
: If she did like you, though...would that change anything?
: No. Right now, you’re the only girl I have my eyes on. And it’ll stay that way for as long as we’re together.
scene otoharinoutside14
: Why...Why’d you even let her into the club in the first place? She doesn’t even play music.
: And you were so excited about it too. It’s almost like you wanted her to join.
: Because I did.
scene otoharinoutside15
: You what?
: I did want her to join. And I’m happy she’s a part of the club.
: But-
: She’s my friend, Otoha. A friend I’ve had for years. So what if I had a crush on her for most of those? She turned me down and I’m with you now.
: I’m not going to just remove her from my life because of a thing that happened that never even went anywhere.
: Rin, don’t take this the wrong way...but you’re not exactly well known for always thinking things through.
scene otoharinoutside16
: That’s kind of hard to not take the wrong way when it makes it sound like you don’t trust me.
: Is that what you’re saying?
: I don’t know what I’m saying. I just...I see the way you look at her and I can’t help but get worried.
: Worried about what? That I’m just waiting for Chika to realize she was wrong and that she does actually want to date me after all?
: See, this is why I didn’t want to talk about it. I know how it sounds. But even if we’re dating now, we still barely even know each other.
: Why wouldn’t you choose Chika over me if she actually did change her mind about you?
scene otoharinoutside17
: Ohhhhh...so that’s how it is.
: What?
: It’s less that you don’t trust me...and more that you’re just jealous.
: You think Chika has something you don’t...and that I’m only dating you because things didn’t work out with her.
scene otoharinoutside18
: That’s not...no. There’s still a lot of context you’re ignoring. Or...missing. Or something.
: Is there? Should I go back to being apprehensive? Or should I stay playful and fun so this conversation doesn’t take a turn for the worse?
scene otoharinoutside19
: Huh?
: Hearing you’re jealous makes me happy. It means you don’t want to lose me. Which is good, because I was half convinced you were kind of indifferent about that at this point.
: Of course not.
: So, what part are you most jealous about? The fact that she has several years of a head start on you? Or the fact that she was the first girl I fell in love with?
scene otoharinoutside20
: The first girl you...fell in love with?
: Should I...not have said the L word? Because I know it’s weird to use it when nothing ever happened, but I still think my feelings at the time were strong enough for me to-
: No, no...I mean...
: Wouldn’t saying first imply that...I’m the second?
scene otoharinoutside21
: ...Noooooo?
: Oh. Okay, yeah. Yeah, because now is still way too soon to start throwing big, serious words like that around.
: Yuuuuuuup.
: And, like...we’re still too young to really even understand what “love” is anyway. Right?
: Yuuuuuu-
scene otoharinoutside22
: Wait, no.
: No?
: Yeah.
: ...Yeah?
: Yeah as in no. Like...I don’t agree with the thing you just said.
: What does it even mean when people say you can’t fall in love until you’re an adult? That makes literally zero sense.
: Do our feelings not count until we reach a certain age? At what point have we lived long enough to fall in love?
: Uhh...I’m just...you know...repeating what I’ve heard before...
: Did you...really feel that strongly about Chika, though?
scene otoharinoutside23
: Uhhhh...
: Will you get jealous again if I say yes?
: Nuh-uh. Because that would imply that I want you to love me and...it would be, like...totally way too early for that sort of thing. You know?
: Rin?
: I did feel that way about her.
: I would have done anything.
scene otoharinoutside24
: But getting my heart broken was a good thing...because it wound up leading me to you.
: If I had never fallen in love with Chika, you and I never would have met. We wouldn’t be here right now trying to work out our problems.
: We wouldn’t be anything.
: You don’t have to be jealous...or worry...or anything like that, Otoha. I’ll be just as loyal to you as you are to me. I promise.
: Besides, Chika’s already sleeping with Sensei anyway, so she’d never even hook up with me in the-
scene otoharinoutside25
: Mm!
: Chika is what?
scene otoharinoutside26
: Nothing! I...I have no idea why I...
: That was a joke, right? Like...there’s no way those two are actually...
scene otoharinoutside27
: I never said that, okay? Erase the last thirty seconds from your memory. I have no idea how I even...
: Neither of them can know, okay? They’re both really important to me and I don’t want anything happening that might change the way they-
: Yeah...Yeah, okay. Yeah, I won’t say anything. Yeah.
: Should, like...
: Should we...tell someone, though?
: Tell them what? What are you talking about?
: That...our teacher is sleeping with a-
: He’s not! They’re not! Just...
scene otoharinoutside28
: That...was just a fantasy of mine! Hahah! Silly, Rin! Always thinking about...people I know...having sex with each other...
scene otoharinoutside29
: Otoha, please...
scene black
scene otoharinoutside30
: So, yeah. That’s basically how you do it.
: So...cool!
: Me? Nah. I’m embarrassing and worthless. I couldn’t even tie my tie this morning, so I had to leave it at home.
: But you? You’ve got a tie on right now. We are not the same.
: What do you think they’re talking about out there?
scene otoharinoutside31
: Hm?
: Rin and Otoha. Rin looks really...panicky for some reason.
: Yeah, she does that.
: I hope they’re not breaking up. I like those two together.
: If they are, this is probably the best possible time since the two of us could cry together about it. But yeah, I hope they’re not either. Even though I have only known Otoha for half an hour.
: Well, whatever it is, I hope it turns out okay. Rin’s been through enough as-is and I really hate seeing her like that.
: Wow. No wonder she liked you for like a billion years. You’re sweet.
scene otoharinoutside32
: Hah...
: She’s just...
: She’s really unlucky.
scene black
scene noonsky
I wound up staying in my office with Noriko for at least another hour.
By the time we left, everyone else had already vacated the school.
Everyone except Rin and Otoha, that is.
But as I walked past them on the way out, neither of them made eye contact with me.
Thankfully, I had Noriko to distract me from their inattentiveness and keep me occupied the rest of the way home.
Once we part ways, though...I can’t help but dredge it up again-
The image of two young girls, just inches apart on a bench-
The mild red hues taking residence in their cheeks-
scene black
And the slew of inappropriate things I think that could mean.
